label: Differentiated squamous epithelium (+ neutrophil signal)
description: Cluster leans toward differentiated squamous epithelial (likely tumor) cells, supported by superficial squamous and barrier genes in M69 (CRNN, KLK13, KRT23, CNFN), M65 (KRT13, KRT4, PPL, SCEL, EVPL), M28 (PI3, KRT24, TGM1, IVL) and M18 (KRT24, TGM1, PPL, SERPINB13). Basal markers (KRT5, KRT14) are absent here and sit in another metagene, so the cells look suprabasal. M0 and M70 carry S100A8/S100A9 at a moderate level, which may reflect neutrophil infiltration or neighbouring-cell bleed; no metagene annotated as a distinct immune lineage carries a sizeable share, so no contaminant is listed. Glandular (M20) and PLAT-high tumor (M42) signals are secondary and low-confidence.
cell_types: Squamous epithelial cells, Tumor epithelial cells
metagene_label: Differentiated squamous epithelium, S100A8/A9-high + Glandular secretory epithelium program
initial_label: Differentiated squamous epithelial cells (+ neutrophil signal)
refine_reason: Aligned the base identity wording with the other differentiated squamous epithelium clusters.

label: Low-quality cells, weak squamous epithelial signal
description: Cluster 1 is small (580 cells) and dominated by diffuse, technical-looking metagenes with no coherent lineage. The largest share is M30 (OR4F17/IST1-high, 14.9%), a probe or multi-mapping artifact, followed by M2 (11.7%), a diffuse high-effective-number factor, and the top genes OR4F17, IST1, SAT1 and ERO1A are all technical or stress-related. Weak squamous/epithelial hints come from M37 (squamous differentiation, 1.6% share, fold 2.5x) and M10 (KRT15 basal-like, 1.5%), and M54 (p53/stress with mucinous tumor-epithelial genes) is similarly weak, but none is strong enough to define an identity. Myeloid M14 (1.9%, fold 1.1) is background. The cluster is most likely a low-quality or technical group with at most a faint squamous epithelial component.

label: Regulatory T cells (CD8 cytotoxic subset)
description: Cluster 2 is a T-lymphocyte cluster: M29 (T cell markers, CD3E/TRAC/TRBC2/CD2/CD247/BCL11B, 11.2% share, 57% of cells) and M83 (regulatory T cell markers, FOXP3/CTLA4/IL2RA/ICOS/TIGIT, 10.5% share, 41% of cells) lead, with top genes TRAC, CD3E, TRBC1/2, CD3D, CD2, CTLA4 all strongly enriched (fold 40-48x). M93 (CD8 cytotoxic T/NK, 5% share in 24% of cells) adds a cytotoxic subset. The remaining metagenes (M8, M13, M89, M60, M64, M58, M94, M2) are diffuse nuclear/RNA-processing background with no lineage, and M75 is a minor stromal stress add-on at 1.8%; these are not treated as contamination.
cell_types: Regulatory T cells, CD4 T cells, CD8 T cells
metagene_label: T cell markers + Regulatory T cell markers

label: Differentiated squamous epithelium (hypoxic, inflamed)
description: Cluster 3 is a differentiated squamous epithelial population. The main signal is the squamous differentiation and cornification metagenes M37 (18.8% share, 56% of cells, fold 79x, with FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL), M15 (SBSN, TGM1, KRTDAP, KLK10) and M69 (CRNN, KLK13, CNFN), with basal KRT5 and TP63 absent. A hypoxia program (M11, 10.7%) and interferon response (M52, 2.7%) add a qualifier. The S100A8/S100A9 signal sits mostly inside the epithelial metagene M37 and M0 rather than a separate myeloid metagene, so it is treated as inflammatory epithelium, not contamination.
cell_types: Squamous epithelial cells, Keratinocytes, Tumor epithelial cells

label: Stromal cells, fibroblast-like (weak signal)
description: Cluster 4 is a small, low-usage cluster dominated by diffuse background factors (M64, M58, M43, M95, about 20% of counts combined) with no coherent lineage. The only identity signal is weak stromal: fibroblast ECM program M4 (COL3A1, SFRP4, LUM, 4.1% share, in 15% of cells, 1.8x) and smooth muscle/myofibroblast add-on M19 (DES, MYH11, TAGLN, 4.0%, 2.6x), with stromal state M75 (C7, RSPO3, CXCL12) also modest. Top genes SFRP4 and CCN2 fit this stromal reading, but enrichment is low (about 2x), so the cluster is most likely a weakly stromal, background-heavy group rather than a clear fibroblast population. No immune or epithelial lineage is supported.
cell_types: Fibroblasts, Smooth muscle cells, Stromal cells

label: B cells (germinal center-leaning)
description: Cluster 5 is dominated by a clean B-cell program: M34 (B cell markers, 16.5% share, present in 81% of cells, fold 84x) with MS4A1, BANK1, BLK, CD79A, CD22, IRF8 and POU2AF1 among the top genes. A germinal-center/follicular B-cell add-on (M33, 6.4% share, 13% of cells, fold 72x) with CXCL13, CR2, GCSAM, AICDA and FCER2 suggests the cluster leans toward a follicular/GC subset within lymphoid aggregates. The remaining metagenes (M79, M8, M13, M9, M2, M60, M89, M64, M58) are diffuse, low-specificity background or unresolved interferon/RNA-processing signal, and no meaningful foreign lineage is present. Myeloid (M14) and stromal (M75) signals are minor and not carried by most cells.
cell_types: B cells, Germinal center B cells

label: Squamous epithelial cells (S100A8/A9-high)
description: Cluster 6 is squamous epithelium, most likely cervical squamous carcinoma or differentiated squamous epithelial cells. Its signal is dominated by squamous metagenes: M0 (differentiated squamous, 11.9%), M5 (KRT13/DSP-high squamous, 8.6%) and M6 (squamous differentiation with hypoxia genes, 6.5%). Top genes support this: KRT13, DSP, DSG3, DSC2, DSC3, PERP, CD24, SERPINB13 and KLK10/11, with KRT5 and basal M1/M26 adding a minor basal component. S100A8/S100A9 are among the top genes and sit mainly in M0, but they are not accompanied by a clear myeloid metagene, so they are treated as part of the epithelial program rather than as contamination. Diffuse metagenes M12, M55 and M46 are background.
cell_types: Squamous epithelial cells, Squamous carcinoma (tumor) cells
metagene_label: Differentiated squamous epithelium, S100A8/A9-high + Squamous epithelium, KRT13/DSP-high

label: Fibroblasts (ECM-rich stroma)
description: Cluster 7 is a stromal fibroblast population. M4 (fibroblast ECM core: COL3A1, SFRP1/4, COL6A1, LUM, PDGFRA, CDH11) carries the largest share (18.5%) and is present in ~70% of cells at 40x enrichment, and the top genes (SFRP4, COL3A1, SFRP1, COL6A1, COL5A1, LUM, COL1A2) confirm it. Activated/CAF-like ECM (M38, POSTN/INHBA/MMP11) and smooth muscle-like matrix (M19, DES/MYH11/TAGLN, in ~38% of cells) add to this stromal identity. No immune or epithelial lineage is enriched; the remaining metagenes (M56, M95, M60, M63, M84, M64, M62, M90, M92) are diffuse low-specificity background.
cell_types: Fibroblasts, Cancer-associated fibroblasts, Smooth muscle cells
metagene_label: Fibroblast ECM markers + Smooth muscle / myofibroblast stroma

label: Endothelial cells (+ pericyte-like signal)
description: Cluster 8 is dominated by endothelial identity: M27 (Endothelial cells, 22.2% share, present in 66% of cells, >100x fold) carries VWF, EGFL7, RAMP2, FLT1, PLVAP, KDR, PECAM1, and top genes VWF, PECAM1, EGFL7, RAMP2, FLT1, MMRN1, KDR confirm blood vessel endothelium. M25 (Pericyte-like cells, NOTCH3/RGS5, 18.1% share, 72% of cells) is a strong vascular mural signal, consistent with endothelial-pericyte co-clustering in tumor vessels, with the stress/activation genes noted. Minor fibroblast (M4, M38) and diffuse factors (M95, M56, M60) add background only.

label: Low-quality stromal cells (technical signal)
description: Cluster 9 is weakly stromal and mostly low-quality. Its largest shares are technical or ambiguous: M30 (OR4F17/IST1 multi-mapping artifact, 13.1%) and M2 (GOLGA/SIGLEC15 diffuse factor, 10.4%), together about 23%. Lineage signal is faint and spread across stromal programs: M4 fibroblast ECM (3.2%, fold 1.4), M19 smooth muscle/myofibroblast (2.6%, fold 1.7) and M27 endothelial (1.3%, fold 2.2), each too small to define a population. The top genes are dominated by OR4F17, IST1, SMG1 and SIGLEC15, with no strong lineage markers. Most cells are unlikely to be a clean cell type, so the cluster is best read as low-quality stroma.
cell_types: Stromal cells, Fibroblasts, Smooth muscle cells

label: Ambiguous diffuse background cluster (weak basal epithelial signal)
description: Cluster 10 has no clear lineage. Its composition is dominated by diffuse, low-specificity factors with no coherent cell-type or pathway theme: M45 (SMG1/IST1/ITCH, 9.2%), M30 (OR4F17/IST1, 9.0%, likely a probe or multi-mapping artifact), M2 (SIGLEC15/GOLGA6L4, 8.4%), M56, M22, M60, M8 and M89, which are nuclear RNA-processing or background factors. The top genes (OR4F17, IST1, SMG1, ZNG1A, SIGLEC15, ITCH, CCNL1) are likewise nonspecific. The only lineage-hinting metagenes are weak: M74 (COL7A1/TP63/ITGB4, 3.7%, in 5.3% of cells) and M10 (KRT15 basal-like squamous, 2.1%, in 4.1% of cells), both too small and too few cells to define the cluster. No contamination lineage is supported.
cell_types: Unassigned low-specificity cells, Basal-like squamous epithelial cells

label: T cells (+ stromal signal)
description: Cluster leans toward T lymphocytes: M29 (T cell markers, 3.3% share, in 28% of cells, fold 2.9) is the strongest lineage metagene, and TRAC, CD3E, GIMAP7, GIMAP4, CD52 and ETS1 are among the top enriched genes. Regulatory T (M83, 2.3%) and cytotoxic CD8/NK (M93, 1.8%) programs add to the lymphoid identity. The top genes are also dominated by technical OR4F17 and IST1 signal, which is ignored for identity. Fibroblast ECM (M4, 3.8%) and smooth muscle/myofibroblast (M19, 3.6%) metagenes give roughly 7% stromal signal, modest and diffuse, so it is treated as contamination rather than a mixed population.
cell_types: T cells, CD8 T/NK cells, Regulatory T cells

label: Squamous epithelium, inflammatory NF-kB state
description: Cluster 12 is a small, low-specificity cluster whose best-supported identity is squamous epithelium (tumor or differentiated keratinocyte-like) in an inflamed NF-kB/TNF-responsive state. Squamous signal comes from M0 (differentiated squamous with S100A8/A9), M5 (squamous, KRT13/DSP) and M15 (cornification genes such as IVL, SBSN, TGM1, present in 13% of cells at 2.5x fold), and the top genes include IVL. Inflammatory signal is carried by M35 (CXCL8, IL1A, PLAU, PPP1R15A, ICAM1) and M36 (TNFAIP2, NFKBIZ). The largest share, M30 (OR4F17/IST1, technical), and M2 (diffuse multi-copy genes) do not define a lineage. The S100A8/A9 weight in M0 may reflect myeloid bleed, but no myeloid lineage metagene is enriched here, so no contamination is called.

label: Squamous epithelial cells (hypoxia/differentiated state)
description: Twenty cells, a tiny cluster of squamous epithelial cells with differentiated and basal features. The lead factor M6 (squamous differentiation with hypoxia genes; SERPINB13, KRT13, DSG3, DSC2, NECTIN4) is 10-fold enriched, and M26 (basal keratinocyte program; KRT15, TP63, ITGA6, ITGB4) and M80 (TP63, COL17A1, LAMB3) add basal-like signal. The top genes SERPINB13, KRT13, DSG3, CTNND1 and MUC4 confirm squamous epithelium, consistent with cervical or tumor epithelium. M45, M30, M87 and M82 are diffuse or artifact-like and carry little identity. Stress and NF-kB factors (M36, M53, M35) are minor.
metagene_label: Squamous differentiation with hypoxia genes + Basal keratinocyte program

label: Fibroblasts (ECM-high, technical noise)
description: Small cluster dominated by technical metagenes (M30 OR4F17/IST1 and M2 SIGLEC15/GOLGA, together about 31% of counts) with no coherent lineage. The lineage signal is fibroblast: M4 (fibroblast ECM, 11.5% share, 5.1x enriched) and the activated-fibroblast add-on M38 carry COL3A1, COL6A1/2, COL5A1, SFRP1/4, TNC and LUM among the top genes. M19 adds a weak smooth-muscle/myofibroblast component. Foreign signals are small: plasma cell M3 (0.5%) and CD8/NK M93 (1.1%), so no meaningful contamination is called.

label: Fibroblasts (weak stromal signal)
description: Cluster 15 is a very small cluster (36 cells) with no dominant lineage. The most identity-informative metagene is the fibroblast ECM program M4 (7.0% share, 3.1x enriched, largest in cluster 33), supported by top genes SFRP4, COL3A1, SFRP1 and COL6A1. Smooth muscle/myofibroblast stroma M19 (3.2%) adds weak support for a stromal identity. Most of the modeled counts sit in diffuse, low-specificity factors (M77 ER translocation, M97 NPM1/nuclear housekeeping), and the Treg (M83, 4.2%) and endothelial (M27, 4.0%) signals are small, background-level shares in few cells, so they are not treated as contamination.
metagene_label: ER protein translocation and glycosylation + NPM1/SMC1A/MED14-high

label: Basal squamous epithelial cells
description: Cluster 16 (5525 cells) is a squamous epithelial cluster. Its identity comes from basal/reserve squamous metagenes M1 (KRT5, TP63, DSP, PERP, NFIB; 9.1% share, 5.0x enriched) and M26 (basal keratinocyte program KRT15, KRT5, TP63, ITGA6, ITGB4, LAMB3; 6.1%, 5.3x), supported by M10 (KRT15, ITGA2, DSC3), M80 (TP63, COL17A1, CYP24A1, IL1R2, DLL1) and M5 (desmosomal/squamous genes DSP, DSC3, PKP1). Top genes KRT15, TP63, ITGB4, ITGA2, LAMB3, CYP24A1 and IL1R2 agree. The profile is diffuse, with many low-specificity factors, and no clear foreign lineage contributes at a meaningful share. A minor cycling signal (M17, 3.1%) is present but is not dominant.
cell_types: Basal squamous epithelial cells, Squamous epithelial cells
metagene_label: Basal squamous epithelial cells + Basal keratinocyte program

label: Glandular epithelium/fibroblast mixture
description: A small, low-confidence cluster mixing glandular/secretory epithelial signal with fibroblast stroma. The largest and most enriched factor is M20 (glandular secretory epithelium, 6.2% share, fold 7.7, in a third of cells), with MUC1, CEACAM7, TMPRSS2 and LYPD2 among the top genes. Fibroblast factors M4 (5.2%) and M38 (3.7%) together carry a comparable share, with COL3A1, COL6A1 and COL6A2 in the top genes. Endothelial M27 and the squamous and proliferation factors are minor. Neither lineage is clearly the cluster's own, so this is called a mixture; the fibroblast signal is not attributed as contamination.
metagene_label: Glandular secretory epithelium program + Fibroblast ECM markers

label: Cycling squamous epithelial cells (tumor-like)
description: Proliferating cluster dominated by cell-cycle programs: M7 (histone and mitotic genes, 8.5% share, 9.9x fold), M17 (S-phase replication, 7.3%), M24 (G1/S), and M39 and M41 (G2/M). Top genes are histone and mitotic genes (H1-5, H3C2, TPX2, MKI67, TOP2A, CENPF, BIRC5). No lineage metagene is strong: the squamous/basal metagenes M1 (6.0%, 18% of cells) and M5 (3.3%) are modest and diffuse, and M74 and M22 are low-confidence. The cluster is most likely cycling tumor cells, probably of squamous origin, but the lineage is not firmly established. Foreign signal is minor, with no clear contaminant.
cell_types: Cycling squamous epithelial cells, Cycling tumor cells
metagene_label: Cycling cells, histone and mitotic genes + S-phase DNA replication program

label: Regulatory T cells (CD4 T cell lineage)
description: Cluster 19 is a small T-lymphocyte population. The Treg factor M83 (FOXP3, CTLA4, IL2RA, ICOS, TIGIT; 7.2% share, present in 38% of cells, 6.4x fold) and the pan-T factor M29 (CD3E, TRAC, TRBC2, CD2, BCL11B; 3.3%) lead the top genes TRAC, CTLA4, CD3E and TRBC1. The largest share, M30 (8.1%), is an OR4F17/IST1 technical artifact and does not define identity. Cytotoxic CD8/NK factor M93 is minor (1.6%), and fibroblast (M4), myeloid (M14) and other signals are at background levels, so no contamination is called.
cell_types: Regulatory T cells, CD4 T cells, T cells

label: Myeloid cells (tumor-associated macrophages)
description: Cluster 20 is a myeloid population. M14 (myeloid, CLEC10A/FCGR2A/CSF1R/LYZ, 22.1% share, in ~80% of cells) is the largest metagene, and M59 (tumor-associated macrophages: C1QA/C1QC, APOE, SPP1, CD163, MMP9, CD14, F13A1; 7.8% share, in ~38% of cells) adds a macrophage core. Top genes (C1QA, C1QC, MMP9, APOE, CD14, CSF1R, FCGR2A, FCER1G, CYBB) agree, with the M59 subset enriched in roughly 38% of cells. The remaining metagenes (M8, M9, M77, M71, M99, M64, M68) are diffuse background with no lineage, and M49 is a shared interferon program. No meaningful foreign lineage signal is present.

label: Stromal/endothelial mixture (IFN-gamma response)
description: Tiny cluster (34 cells) with no dominant lineage. The largest share is an IFN-gamma response program (M49, 8.7%; CXCL10, CXCL9, STAT1, TAP1, GBP1), which is shared across lineages. Stromal signal is the main identity: fibroblast ECM (M4, 6.5%), activated ECM-remodeling fibroblasts (M38, 5.1%) and smooth muscle/myofibroblast stroma (M19, 3.3%) together make up about 15%, with COL3A1, COL6A1, COL4A1 and SFRP4 among the top genes. Endothelial signal (M27, 6.0%; VWF, EGFL7, RAMP2) is comparable, so the cluster reads as a stromal/vascular mixture. CD8/NK cytotoxic signal (M93, 3.7%, in about 12% of cells) is a small foreign component, possibly doublets. Most diffuse metagenes are background.
cell_types: Fibroblasts, Endothelial cells, Smooth muscle/stromal cells
metagene_label: IFN-gamma response program + Fibroblast ECM markers

label: Differentiated squamous epithelium (inflamed)
description: Small cluster of 36 cells dominated by the diffuse, non-lineage factor M45 (26.8%), so the call rests on the minor metagenes. The most coherent identity is squamous epithelium: M37 (squamous differentiation with FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL, 13.9% of cells) and M0 (differentiated squamous epithelium with KRT13, KRT4, CD24, DSC2) are supported by top genes CRNN and ECM1. M17 (S-phase program, 7.5%) suggests some cycling cells, and M70 adds a differentiated surface signal. Macrophage metagene M59 (3.1%, 8.3% of cells) and fibroblast metagene M38 (2.0%) are below the contamination threshold and are not called. Confidence is low because the cluster is tiny and most of its counts sit in diffuse background factors.
refine_reason: Aligned wording with the standard differentiated squamous epithelium label.

label: Fibroblasts (+ macrophage signal, diffuse background)
description: Cluster 23 is a small, low-signal cluster whose best-supported identity is fibroblasts. M4 (fibroblast ECM, 10.1% share, 4.5x enriched) and M38 (activated fibroblasts, 2.2%) carry COL3A1, COL6A1, SFRP1/4 and TNC, and these genes are among the top modeled genes. Diffuse background factors M58 and M64 (about 26% combined) dominate the counts and add no lineage, so the call is weak. Smaller foreign signals are macrophage (M59, 7.3%, largest in cluster 20, present in only 2.5% of cells), plus T-cell (M29, 3.8%) and IgG plasma-cell (M3, 2.1%) signals, which are best read as contamination or doublets.
contaminants: Tumor-associated macrophages, T cells, Plasma cells

label: Fibroblasts (+ sparse lymphocyte signal)
description: Cluster 24 is a small (39 cells) stromal cluster led by fibroblast ECM metagene M4 (11.2% share, fold 5.0x, in only 5.1% of cells), with top genes COL3A1, SFRP1, SFRP4, COL6A1, TNC and COL5A1 supporting fibroblasts. Lymphoid signal is present but minor: M93 CD8 cytotoxic T/NK (5.4% share, fold 9.8x, in 2.6% of cells), M29 T cell markers and M34 B cell markers, which look like sparse doublets or spillover in a few cells. The remaining metagenes (M58, M40, M9, M51, M94, M95, M46, M43, M62) are diffuse background, and M37 and M96 are weak epithelial-differentiation signals. The cluster's identity is fibroblastic; the fibroblast share is modest and most cells are not dominated by it.
contaminants: CD8 T/NK lymphocytes, T cells, B cells

label: IgG plasma cells (ER stress high)
description: Cluster 25 is dominated by plasma cell signal: M3 (IgG plasma cell markers, 14.1%, in 54% of cells), M31 (plasma cell immunoglobulin program, 5.8%) and M23 (IgG plasma cell markers, 1.8%, in 7% of cells) together with top genes IGHG1, IGKC, XBP1, MZB1, DERL3, PRDM1 and IRF4 support antibody-secreting plasma cells, mainly IgG-class. The largest share, M53 (ER stress/UPR, 24.9%), is a diffuse secretory-stress program whose core plasma-cell genes are weak, but it fits plasma cells' high secretory load. Fibroblast (M4, 3.1%) and other minor signals are small and diffuse, with no strong foreign lineage.
metagene_label: ER stress unfolded protein response + IgG plasma cell markers

label: Fibroblasts and smooth muscle stroma (+ minor T cell signal)
description: Stromal cluster. Fibroblast ECM genes dominate (M4 at 6.0% share, M38 at 5.5%, with COL3A1, COL6A1, SFRP4, CCN2, LTBP2 and THBS1 among the top genes), and smooth muscle/perivascular genes (M19 at 13.9%, 9.2x enriched, with TAGLN, MYLK, ACTG2, DES, GREM1) are the largest and most enriched signal. T-cell metagene M29 (7.4% share, in only about 6% of cells) is a small foreign signal, most likely doublets or spillover in a few cells, and is not the cluster's identity. Diffuse housekeeping factors (M64, M62, M76, M84, M82) carry no lineage.
metagene_label: Smooth muscle / myofibroblast stroma + T cell markers

label: Squamous epithelium, inflammatory NF-kB state
description: Small cluster (50 cells) dominated by a diffuse TNF/NF-kB inflammatory program (M36, TNFAIP2, NFKB2, NFKBIZ, NFKBIA), which is the largest share but has low specificity. The best lineage evidence is squamous: M69 (CRNN-high, fold 4.0), M37 (FLG, CRNN, IVL, fold 5.9), M5 (DSP, KRT13) and CRNN itself at 4.5x fold, which together make up roughly 12% of counts. Lymphoid signal (M29 T cells, M93 CD8/NK) is small, about 6% combined and in few cells, so it is treated as background and not listed as contamination. Stromal and background metagenes are minor. The lineage call is tentative because the squamous metagenes are present in only a few cells each and the NF-kB program carries most of the signal.
cell_types: Squamous epithelial cells, Inflamed epithelial cells
refine_reason: Aligned NF-kB squamous wording with cluster 12.

label: Fibroblasts (activated, ECM-remodeling)
description: Cluster 28 is a small fibroblast cluster. M4 (fibroblast ECM core, 41% of counts, in 81.5% of cells) and M38 (activated/ECM-remodeling fibroblast state, 21%, in 33% of cells) dominate, with top genes COL3A1, COL6A1/2, COL5A1/2, SFRP1/4, TNC, LUM, COL1A2 and MMP11. Foreign signal is minor: M3 plasma cell (3.3%, 3.7% of cells) and M37 squamous/inflamed (4.5%, 11% of cells) are below the contamination threshold and are noted only as background.

refine_reason: Aligned activated-fibroblast wording with the standard label; M38 share (21.2%) supports the state.

label: Squamous epithelium/fibroblast mixture (+ T cell signal)
description: Tiny, low-confidence cluster with two comparable lineages. Squamous differentiation metagene M37 (fold 10.4x; FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL, SCEL) is the most enriched signal, with epithelial support from M70 and M42. Stromal metagenes M4 (fibroblast ECM: COL3A1, SFRP1, SFRP4), M19 (smooth muscle/myofibroblast: TAGLN, MYLK, CCN2) and M75 are comparable in share and carry several top genes (SFRP4, COL3A1, CCN2, THBS1). Treg (M83) and CD8/NK (M93) are small minor signals, likely spillover or doublets. The diffuse ambiguous metagenes (M89, M98, M58, M72, M64, M99, M84) are housekeeping background and do not inform identity.
metagene_label: Squamous differentiation, inflamed + Smooth muscle / myofibroblast stroma

label: Differentiated squamous epithelium (inflamed)
description: Small cluster of 32 cells whose identity is squamous epithelium in a differentiated, superficial or inflamed state. The strongest signal is M37 (squamous differentiation with S100A8 and hypoxia genes; fold 11.6x), backed by M15 (cornification genes IVL, SBSN, TGM1, KRTDAP) and M6 (differentiated squamous genes SERPINB13, KRT13, DSG3 with hypoxia genes). M0 adds a squamous S100A8/A9-high component. The top genes (ERO1A, IVL, CRNN, FLG, CRCT1) match this. Basal markers KRT5, KRT14 and TP63 are absent, so the cells are not basal. Most other metagenes are diffuse, low-specificity housekeeping factors with no lineage. IGHG1 is enriched among the top genes, but no listed metagene supports plasma-cell contamination, so none is called.

label: Differentiated squamous epithelium
description: Cluster of 30 cells whose own identity is differentiated squamous epithelium: M37 (squamous differentiation, 12.4% share, 19x enriched) and M15 (cornification genes, IVL, TGM1, KRTDAP, KLK7) are led by top genes FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL, IL36A and RNASE7, while basal KRT5/KRT14 are absent. Foreign signal is modest: T-cell metagene M29 (7.2%, largest in cluster 2) and fibroblast ECM metagene M4 (6.2%, largest in cluster 33) are contamination in a minority of cells, and IgG plasma-cell M3 (1.6%, IGHG1 among top genes) is minor. Diffuse factors (M2, M86, M97, M81) are ignored as background.
contaminants: T cells, Fibroblasts, IgG plasma cells
metagene_label: Squamous differentiation, inflamed + T cell markers
refine_reason: Aligned wording with the standard differentiated squamous epithelium label.

label: Squamous epithelial cells (inflamed, low purity)
description: Small, mostly diffuse cluster with no dominant lineage. The most coherent identity signal is M37 (squamous differentiation, FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL, 6.2% share, present in about 12% of cells, 9.5x enriched), suggesting a superficial keratinizing squamous epithelial population with inflammatory and hypoxic genes (S100A8, ERO1A, IL1A). Most other metagenes (M45, M50, M58, M56, M64, M2, M57, M98, M89, M86, M90, M91) are low-specificity background factors and are not used. M29 (T cell markers, 4.1% share, 12% of cells) is a minor foreign signal under 5%, so it is noted as possible background rather than contamination. Calls are low confidence given the tiny cluster size and weak lineage evidence.

label: Fibroblasts (activated, ECM-remodeling)
description: Cluster 33 is a small (119 cells) fibroblast population. M4 (fibroblast ECM markers: COL3A1, SFRP4, SFRP1, COL6A1, TNC, LUM, PDGFRA) carries 42% of counts in 92% of cells at 18.9x fold, and the top genes (COL3A1, SFRP4, SFRP1, COL6A1/2, COL5A1/2, COL1A2, LUM, DIO2, IGF1) confirm a fibroblast identity. M38 (activated/ECM-remodeling fibroblast, POSTN, INHBA, MMP11) adds 13% in 45% of cells, suggesting a cancer-associated fibroblast state.
